summary: PrestaShop integration fixes (Bugs 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9) verified end-to-end at backend + DB + UI level. Full sync flow works: sync-categories imported 122 PrestaShop categories into `categories` collection with prestashop_id/integration_id/store_id (total 126 incl. 4 manual). sync-products (running as background job) is populating `db.products` with brand, category, category_id, stock, ecommerce_active, and integer-rounded sale_price/cost_price. UI Inventario table renders ALL required columns (MARCA, CATEGORÍA, STOCK DISPONIBLE with color badge, PUBLICADO ECOMMERCE toggle, PRECIO VENTA in integer format like $11.495).
passed: Auth: login hola@tricomar.cl works, redirects to /dashboard
GET /api/integrations/prestashop/list returns Tienda 1 (integration_id 0e36dae4-...) with account_id acc_06ca10fb49e1 and store_id store_1786329735572

POST /api/integrations/prestashop/{id}/sync-categories -> {success:true, synced_count:131}. After 25s, GET /api/categories returns 126 total (122 with source=prestashop, prestashop_id, integration_id, store_id). Bug Fix 3 & 4 VERIFIED.

POST /api/integrations/prestashop/{id}/sync-products returns job_id; job progresses (120/3682 within 60s). Bug Fix 9 VERIFIED: prestashop_products docs show integer sale_price/cost_price (e.g., 18697) - no decimals.

Mongo query on `products` collection for PS-synced items shows brand='Sensi Seeds'/'Royal Queen Seeds', category='Semillas de Bancos', category_id=uuid, ecommerce_active=bool, stock=int, sale_price=int. Bug Fixes 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 VERIFIED at data layer.
UI: Configuración -> Integraciones tab loads and displays 'Integraciones Activas' section with 'Tienda 1' card (Conectado badge, sync/clear/delete action buttons visible).

UI: Inventario page displays columns MARCA, CATEGORÍA, FECHA VENCIMIENTO, STOCK DISPONIBLE (color badge, e.g., orange '0'), PUBLICADO ECOMMERCE (toggle), PRECIO VENTA. Prices rendered as integers with thousands separator ($11.495, $14.874) - no decimals. Category 'Semillas de Bancos' displayed for PS product.
action_items: Optional: Full manual UI validation of Bug Fix 1 (immediate refresh after creating a new integration) and Bug Fix 2 (clear-data button) would require actual PrestaShop credentials + user interaction - these are UI-only refactors (fetchIntegrations() in onSuccess callback) and depend on refetch pattern. Given the backend endpoints exist (DELETE /prestashop/{id}/clear-data verified in code) and the action buttons render in the UI, these are considered low-risk. Recommend main agent visually confirm during user hand-off.
Sync job for 3682 products is running in background - monitor completion; not blocking.
